decisions.reason: The evening day-patient program builds on the firm's established psychiatric offer, has its own page signalling visible commitment, and likely required staff and regulatory investment, so management will persist and attribute slow uptake to the start-up phase.

The carpentry workshop extends existing sheltered-workshop production with invested equipment and its own page, and it serves the firm's participation mission, so management will justify continuing it despite modest sales.

Outpatient sociotherapy is close to the firm's core and fits its announced outpatient direction, but it is only mentioned on the website, so commitment is less visible and dropping it would be easier.
The senior living counseling service is shown on the home page, which signals strong public commitment and centrality to the eldercare direction, and its low cost makes continuation very likely.

The retail shop builds on workshop output and supports inclusion goals, but its low visibility and the real costs of shop operation make it the most vulnerable product, though sunk investment still favors keeping it.
